title: galarhoeus corallioides
intro: Galarhoeus corallioides, commonly known as Coral root, is a type of plant in the nettle family (Urticaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Coral root include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe coughs and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of Coral root include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to relax smooth muscles and thin mucus.
